newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police target 800 over paedophile videos.
newsitem.headline: French police target 800 over paedophile videos.

text.p: Some 2,500 gendarmes fanned out across France on Tuesday in a crackdown on paedophile video fans, a gendarmerie spokesman said.
He said that 14 months of investigation had led gendarmes to a mail-order company in the central town of Macon selling pornographic films involving boys.
The para-military police intended to search the homes of 800 people whose names were found on the company's mailing list.
One hundred and twenty suspects had been detained since the operation was launched early in the morning, the spokesman said.
France's first major paedophilia trial opened in Paris on Monday, with 71 Frenchmen accused of organising or subscribing to a network selling pornographic films involving boys.
